summary: EQT Infrastructure Company LLC filed a routine Form 8-K on September 23, 2026, reporting that its manager EQT Partners Inc. set the Transactional Net Asset Value per share as of August 31, 2026, the price at which the interval fund sells and repurchases shares. NAV per share ranges from $25.26 (Class M-S-TE) to $29.40 (Class H, Q, T). Assets at fair value totaled $670.2 million against $587.5 million cost, with $416.7 million cash. Total Transactional NAV was $1.085 billion across 37.9 million shares; no special-situation event.
